name: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: `T` need not implement `Copy` for this operation to be permitted. If `T` does not implement `Copy`, using both the source values and their destination copies is not guaranteed to be memory-safe.
api: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
